pngsuite/ holds the PngSuite test images by Willem van Schaik (http://www.schaik.com/pngsuite/),
release of 2017-07-19 (PngSuite-2017jul19.tgz, sha256 0294b244c95a8342c01b00010cf34abdcabc7c6a34fd0fe1bd963917537bfdc8).
Terms (pngsuite/PngSuite.LICENSE): "Permission to use, copy, modify and distribute these images for any purpose and
without fee is hereby granted."  (c) Willem van Schaik, 1996, 2011.

pages/ holds two synthetic page images from a bug report (page-a.png, page-b.png). Their deflate data hits a case the inflater once decoded wrongly: a long-code literal followed by a long-code length/distance pair in the fast loop.
